name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
summary: At the Violet Citadel, Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver oversees Kirin Tor work as Dalaran is rebuilt. A senior human wizard on the Council of Six, he survived the Scourge's destruction of the city. His willful daughter ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate.

sections.title: A Pillar of the Kirin Tor
sections.body: Ansirem Runeweaver helped defend Dalaran for decades. He holds a seat on the Council of Six, which rules the Kirin Tor. He survived when Arthas Menethil and the Scourge marched on the city and Archimonde was summoned. After Dalaran fell, Ansirem joined the effort to rebuild it. The protective shield came down early, and he now works from the Violet Citadel.

sections.title: Far-Flung Interests
sections.body: Ansirem's ties reach beyond the Alterac Mountains. His willful daughter, Catelyn, ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate, taking an ancient troll dagger he found while researching in Stranglethorn. Ansirem has dealt with Baron Revilgaz there. He has also studied troll antiquities and keeps diplomatic conduits open across distant realms.

faq.answer: Ansirem is an accomplished human wizard and one of the six ruling archmages on the Kirin Tor's Council of Six. After decades defending Dalaran, he now oversees work around the rebuilt city and its arcane perimeter.

Ansirem's willful daughter, Catelyn, ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate, where she is known as Catelyn the Blade. She took an ancient troll dagger that Ansirem found while researching in Stranglethorn.

faq.q: What is his role in Dalaran?
faq.answer: Ansirem is a leading Kirin Tor presence in the Violet Citadel. He coordinates research, magical defense and communication with allies as Dalaran is rebuilt after the Third War's destruction.

faq.q: Did Ansirem fight in the Third War?
faq.answer: Yes. Ansirem helped defend Dalaran for decades and survived the Scourge's siege. Arthas guarded Kel'Thuzad's summoning of Archimonde. Ansirem lived through the city's destruction and now helps rebuild it.

angles.text: As a Mage, you can look to Ansirem, a revered member of the Council of Six, for guidance in disciplined arcane study.
As an Alliance member, you share interests with Ansirem, a Kirin Tor leader based in Lordaeron. Human spellcasters struggle to reclaim their lands from Scourge remnants.
